summary: I officially submitted the grant this morning @ 9:15 AM. I'm proud of it and hope it gets funded. Time to forget I ever applied while I await feedback.
I finished the grant today! I bound all the documents together into one big, beautiful PDF. I printed it and read through it. I’ll wait until tomorrow to submit it, but I’m really proud of it!

I spent yesterday and a little of today overhauling my specific aims based on my mentor's feedback. I sent it to her for a second round of feedback, and she already got back to me saying she likes it much more! 3 days left!

I received feedback from my mentor on the proposal. The biggest concerns were related to the specific aims and the methods issue. I've spent all day working on integrating her feedback. I think the proposal is getting stronger! Also, this update marks 100 hours of working on this proposal!
I finished up my biosketch today (woo!), and then got started on my abstract. Only a few more documents left to go!

I banged my head against a wall for several hours today while working on my biosketch -- these are my least favorite parts of any grant. I've made some progress, but I'm not done yet. I'll return to it tomorrow. The grant is due in 7 days. Eeek!
Today, I completed drafts of the Human Subjects (IRB) document and the key personnel document. I also started working on my biosketch.
I've completed a draft of the Management Plan and Budget document. I also began working on the Human Subjects document (i.e., the IRB status document).
I have a completed full draft of my research plan, woo!
Sent off my materials to my consultant for their letter of support.
Worked on integrating coauthors' feedback on the Qualtrics survey.
body: Over the past week, my colleagues gave feedback to Danika and me regarding the Qualtrics survey. Today, I worked to integrate the feedback.

summary: Met with Danika to incorporate the implementation science constructs into the survey questions.
